title: verification on a real microphone and speaker

clauses.text: Read-aloud and dictation work with a real microphone and speakers

steps.do: Plug in a USB microphone and speakers (or use the built-in ones). Open VOICE, READ ALOUD, paste a paragraph and press Play. Then DICTATE and speak one sentence.
steps.expect: The paragraph is clear and easy to follow from the speakers. The spoken sentence appears as text you can read back.
